Frequently asked questions

Are you open 24 hours?

Yes. We are open every hour of every day. Call 0722 306 273 before you come if you can.

Where are you located?

We are in Shabab, next to Quickmart, in Nakuru City.

What services do you offer?

Outpatient and inpatient care, maternity, child welfare, ultrasound, laboratory, pharmacy, dental, physiotherapy, circumcision, special clinics and surgery.

How do I book an appointment?

Call 0722 306 273, email cityscopemedical@gmail.com, or use the booking form on this page.

Can I get medicines at the centre?

Yes. We have a pharmacy on site.
